newsitem.title: USA: Mercury Finance remains halted on NYSE.
newsitem.headline: Mercury Finance remains halted on NYSE.

text.p: The New York Stock Exchange said trading in shares of Mercury Finance Co remain halted under a "continued delayed opening for news dissemination."
An exchange spokeswoman said no price indication had been established, though traders said Mercury traded at 4-1/4 overseas, down from 14-7/8, the last NYSE trade in the share on January 28.
The company said yesterday it discovered accounting irregularities, wiping out $90 million in earnings over the last four years.
The company also said its chief financial officer James Doyle has apparently disappeared.

After Mercury's announcement, Piper Jaffray said it cut its recommendation on the company to market performer from buy, while Gruntal & Co said it suspended its rating on the stock and recommended holders exit their positions "as soon as possible."
Also, it was reported shareholders have filed a class action lawsuit against the company.
